# =============================================================================
# radix-lane — Braced canonical @ radix लेन routing record for the Rust
# HIR-direct लेन.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Compiler लेन routing — `@ radix { लेन = "hir-direct" }` selects a
#     specific backend compilation लेन
#   • Braced annotation syntax — the key-value pair specifies the लेन
#     identifier for the Radix compiler
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • missing `@ annotatio` on a contract वर्ग, or specifying an invalid or unsupported compiler लेन name
#
# See also: radix, annotation-sugar
# =============================================================================

@ radix { लेन = "hir-direct" }
fn loss() → int {
    return 1
}

main {
    print loss()
}
